name: Easy!Appointments
description: Easy!Appointments is a self-hosted appointment scheduler that lets customers book appointments online from a public booking page. Admins manage services, providers, working plans and secretaries in a backend calendar, with email notifications, Google Calendar and CalDAV sync, LDAP login and a REST API.

notes.text: Sign in at http://<IP>/index.php/login with the admin login saved in /opt/easyappointments_data/.env inside the container.
Email notifications need an SMTP server: set protocol and the smtp_* values in /opt/easyappointments/application/config/email.php.
Behind a reverse proxy, add fastcgi_param PROXY_IPS <proxy-ip>; to /etc/nginx/sites-available/easyappointments, or all visitors share one login rate limit.
